figures.text_says: The figure is explicitly labeled 'Inventory Department View'. The accompanying requirements (12–19) describe a matrix display of inventory categories, with requirements that unused cells appear empty, that cells show category names as hyperlinks based on category type, and that an 'Under $5' category name is NOT a hyperlink (15.2.3.1). Requirement 13.2 states the matrix must be able to hold at least 30 tiles.

The categories are arranged in a 5-row by 4-column matrix (20 total cells). All visible cells are filled with category names. The cell in the first row, second column contains 'Appliances Under $5' rendered as a blue, underlined hyperlink. No empty unused cells are illustrated, and there is no visible distinction indicating which categories contain subcategories.
figures.issue: Two direct inconsistencies: (1) Requirement 15.2.3.1 states that for an Under $5 category 'The category name is not a hyperlink,' but the figure clearly shows 'Appliances Under $5' as a blue underlined hyperlink. (2) Requirement 13.2 requires the matrix to hold at least 30 tiles at each level, but the figure depicts only a 5×4 matrix (20 cells), which fails to illustrate the required capacity.

figures.text_says: The figure illustrates the 'Inventory Category View' where inventory categories/subcategories are presented in a fixed-dimension matrix format. Each occupied cell displays a category name as a hyperlink; unused cells are shown empty. The top-left cell always represents a generic item (e.g., 'Generic Refrigerator'). The matrix must accommodate at least 30 tiles at each level, categories are listed alphabetically, and any cell that contains subcategories must indicate that fact visually.
figures.image_shows: A UI wireframe containing a left-side vertical 'Departments' list, a breadcrumb 'Appliances > Refrigerator', and a 4×5 grid matrix on the right. The matrix's first row has four hyperlinks: 'Generic Refrigerator', 'Refrigerator, Bottom Freezer', 'Refrigerator, Side by Side', and 'Refrigerator, Top Freezer'. All other matrix cells are empty. A 'View All Items' button appears to the right of the matrix. There are no additional visual indicators (icons, arrows, badges, etc.) to show that a cell contains subcategories.
figures.issue: Two main inconsistencies: (1) Capacity requirement mismatch — Req 2.2 states the matrix must be able to hold at least 30 tiles, but the figure shows a 4×5 grid with only 20 cells. (2) Missing subcategory visual indicator — Req 6 requires each cell to indicate visually when it contains subcategories; the figure shows only plain text hyperlinks, which are also specified for leaf/unique item categories (Req 4.2), so there is no distinguishing visual cue for subcategories.
